The University has an integrated core curriculum that enables students to work with knowledge drawn from across disciplines, thus creating a powerful learning experience that emphasises integrative learning, critical thinking and creative problem-solving. Explore our programmes to find the best fit for you. Related Links About LUMS Rankings and Accreditation Contact Us LUMS has a programme for everyone With 21 undergraduate and 29 graduate level degrees to choose from, LUMS has a programme for everyone. Our five Schools have nurtured leaders in areas ranging from entrepreneurship, economics, biology, mathematics, engineering , education, writing, politics and business. Whatever your interest and passion, LUMS offers you a transformative experience and prepares you for lifetime of learning.
